quote: I used to check the portal inbox at my daughter's soccer games. Now I open the CRM on Monday and the weekend viewings are already in the calendar, with notes on what each buyer wants.
name: Dana Whitfield

quote: The phone used to ring out while we were checking someone in, and we would find the voicemails at lunch. Now the diary fills itself overnight and we deal with the people standing in front of us.
name: Priya Nair

quote: My reps stopped doing notes at nine at night. The Friday pipeline meeting went from an hour and a half of asking what happened to forty minutes on the deals that are stuck.
name: Tom Halloran

quote: We were nervous about a machine touching client books. What settled it was the exceptions list. My team checks the 300 odd invoices that look wrong and no longer types in the 1,600 that are fine.
name: Layla Haddad

quote: Half our enquiries come in from other time zones while we are asleep. They now get an answer in English or Arabic and a call booked for the morning, so my team starts the day with appointments and not a backlog.
name: Omar Rahman

quote: The audit was the useful part for me. We were told two of the five things we wanted to automate were not worth the money yet, and we started with recall reminders only.
name: Elena Ruiz
